segments.speaker: Megan Ellis, Rep
segments.text:
Hi Jordan,

Attached is the revised quote for 42 seats of GaugeTrack, calibration scheduling, and the asset import. Target go-live is January 13, assuming we get the PO by December 18.

Annual subscription is $45,600, implementation is $7,500, Net 30.

Megan

segments.speaker: Jordan Pike, Customer
segments.text:
Megan,

Thanks. Seat count is right. We may add 6 more techs in Q2 but don't include them now.

Can you confirm the implementation includes migrating our 3,200 active instruments and the overdue cert history from the spreadsheet?

Jordan

segments.speaker: Megan Ellis, Rep
segments.text:
Yes, implementation covers the 3,200 active instruments, locations, intervals, owners, and last/next due dates. We can bring over the cert PDFs if your team puts them in the folder structure we discussed.

The only add-on would be barcode label setup if you want us to design the templates.

Megan

segments.speaker: Jordan Pike, Customer
segments.text:
Okay. Leave barcode labels out.

On the price, per our texts last night, we settled on $38,400 for year one instead of the $45,600 on the quote. I know that discount is supposed to go through deal desk and show concession approval, but let's not wait on that route. You said if I get the signature back this week, you can hold the cheaper number and clean up the paperwork later so the order form and billing tool catch up after. That's the number I'm taking to finance.

Jordan

segments.speaker: Megan Ellis, Rep
segments.text:
Jordan,

Understood. I'll send a clean order form today with 42 seats, no barcode add-on, Jan 13 go-live, annual invoice, Net 30.

Megan

segments.speaker: Jordan Pike, Customer
segments.text:
Send it to me and copy Priya in procurement. She needs vendor address, tax ID, and remittance instructions on the invoice.

Also, our PO will reference calibration software subscription and services. That okay?

Jordan

segments.speaker: Megan Ellis, Rep
segments.text:
Yes, that description is fine.

I'll include our W-9, vendor form, and remittance details with the order form. Invoice will go out after countersignature unless you need it held until the PO is issued.

Megan

segments.speaker: Jordan Pike, Customer
segments.text:
Hold invoice until PO. Our AP team kicks back anything without a PO number.

If we sign by Friday, can your implementation lead still do kickoff on December 22?

Jordan

segments.speaker: Megan Ellis, Rep
segments.text:
Yes. December 22 at 11:00 a.m. Eastern is still open. Kickoff agenda is data import, user roles, due-date rules, and the January 13 go-live checklist.

I'll send the packet in a few minutes.

Megan
